value.value: Figure 4A MUA/MPA 3/5/10 nm at 20/80/160 µg/mL, 22 h, mean ± SD, representative of three independent experiments, p < 0.05. Figure 4B AUT/CYST at 0.5/3.5/20 µg/mL, 22 h, mean ± SD, p < 0.01. Axes are absorbance; panel B caption calls values fold change, so do not relabel axis numerically as a verified fold-change dataset. The positive-QD bar panels list 0.5/3.5/20 µg/mL in their legends/captions, but 5 and 10 nm CYST groups show only two bars; a 20 µg/mL result is not inferred for those groups.

value.value: MUA 3/5 nm and AUT generally reduce WST-1 response; 10 nm MUA has little effect. CYST 3 nm decreases while CYST 5/10 nm increase response at some doses. Authors caution apparent proliferation may reflect surviving-cell population; this is not a direct mechanistic growth-rate measurement.
